subject: Re: Candescent onboarding — transition playbook & kickoff timeline
messages:
From: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@candescent.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: onboarding@candescent.ai
Date: 2027-08-01T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Candescent onboarding — MAP + target go-live

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Leadership is ready to move forward and asked for a clear mutual action plan (MAP) and an operational timeline so internal stakeholders know who owns what and when. Target go-live for our initial integration is Sept 28, but VP product wants to see a milestone-level plan by EOD Monday.

Can your team draft a MAP that lists: milestones, owner (Redwood/Candescent), prerequisites, and realistic dates? A separate sheet for technical prework (network, access, sample data) would be helpful. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful — we can do 2pm PT Tuesday.

Attaching a one-page product brief for context (sent separately).

Thanks,
Sanjay Gupta
Head of Product
Candescent AI

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@candescent.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candescent onboarding — MAP + target go-live

Sanjay — thanks, and congrats on the green light. We can get a draft MAP to you by EOD Monday. High-level proposal below (we'll expand to the spreadsheet):

- Week 0 (Aug 9–13): Kickoff + access provisioning (Owner: Candescent sets up VPC peering & provides sample dataset; Redwood provides onboarding SSO links)
- Week 1 (Aug 16–20): Technical prework & test prompts (Owner: Redwood SE/evelyn_hart for integration; Candescent for sample data)
- Week 2–3 (Aug 23–Sep 3): Iterative model tuning, latency/cost targets & validation (Owners: Redwood engineering + Candescent product)
- Week 4 (Sep 6–10): UAT and security review (Owners: Candescent security & Redwood compliance)
- Week 6 (Sep 20–28): Go/no-go and cutover window (Owners: joint)

I'll loop in Marissa (CS) and Lauren (implementation) to capture milestone-level owners and a realistic schedule. Marcus Lin (implementation eng) will be assigned to run the deployment workstreams.

Proposed kickoff time: Tue Aug 3, 2pm PT works for me. If that works for you, I'll send a calendar invite and an agenda.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@candescent.ai>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-02T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP & owners (v0.1) — Candescent onboarding

Hi Sanjay / Jonas — attaching a first-pass MAP (Candescent_MAP_v0.1.xlsx) that breaks out milestones, owners, acceptance criteria, and target dates. High-level notes:

- Milestone 1: Kickoff + stakeholder alignment
  - Owner: Candescent (provide stakeholder list) / Redwood (facilitate)
  - Target: 2027-08-03
  - Acceptance: kickoff minutes and action register

- Milestone 2: Network & access provisioning
  - Owner: Candescent IT / Redwood infra (verify connectivity)
  - Target: 2027-08-10
  - Prereq: VPC peering + IP allowlist

- Milestone 3: Test corpus + sample calls (performance baseline)
  - Owner: Candescent product / Redwood SE
  - Target: 2027-08-18

- Milestone 4: Model tuning & cost guardrails
  - Owner: Redwood applied ML + Candescent product
  - Target: 2027-09-01

- Milestone 5: Security & compliance sign-off
  - Owner: Candescent security / Redwood compliance
  - Target: 2027-09-08

- Milestone 6: UAT & go/no-go
  - Owner: Joint
  - Target: 2027-09-22 — 2027-09-28 (cutover window)

Action items we need from Candescent today to firm dates: sample dataset access, list of internal approvers for security and product, and the primary SSO admin.

I've included a separate tab named "Technical Prework" that lists tasks for Evelyn and Marcus (network tests, key rotation strategy, initial quantization profile). Marcus — can you confirm the time estimate for the deployment runbook rows 10–14?

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: Candescent_MAP_v0.1.xlsx

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@candescent.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-02T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Draft MAP & owners (v0.1) — Technical prework notes

Thanks — quick technical notes and owner confirmations from the SE side:

- Network validation: I will run connectivity tests once Candescent shares IP ranges. ETA: 2 business days after access is provided (Target 2027-08-12 if access on 8/10).
- API keys / secrets: Recommend customer-managed KMS; plan includes HSM integration option in case compliance requires it. Owner: Candescent infra + Redwood infra (Marcus).
- Sample dataset ingestion: We need a sanitized 500–1,000-record sample to get representative latency and token counts. Owner: Candescent data team. Target: 2027-08-16.
- Canary rollout: Suggest 5% traffic first week, 25% second week, then full traffic post-UAT. Owner: Redwood runtime + Candescent ops.

I'll add these rows to the technical prework tab and flag two blockers: (1) access to test VPC by 8/10 and (2) confirmation of SSO metadata.

Evelyn Hart
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@quantumhealth.co>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@candescent.ai>
Date: 2027-08-03T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement / PO template & billing cadence

Team — looping in procurement on behalf of Candescent. Before we lock dates we need an initial SOW or PO template and an outline of billing cadence (monthly vs net 30 invoicing). Attached is our PO template (Candescent_PO_Template.pdf). Can Redwood confirm: 1) standard SOW lead time; 2) any up-front invoice for reserved capacity; and 3) point of contact for billing questions.

Please note procurement would prefer net 30 and one consolidated invoice per month.

Best,
Elaine Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Candescent (procurement partner)
Attachment: Candescent_PO_Template.pdf

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@candescent.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@quantumhealth.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-03T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Finalizing MAP v0.1 + next steps (kickoff meeting confirmed)

Folks — thanks for the fast responses. Quick summary and agreed next steps: 

1) Kickoff: Tue Aug 3, 2pm PT — confirmed. Agenda attached (redwood-kickoff-agenda.pdf).
2) Deliverables before kickoff: Candescent to share sample dataset and IP ranges by EOD Aug 4.
3) Redwood deliverable: MAP v0.2 (updated ownership & dates) and deployment runbook by Aug 6.
4) Procurement: Redwood will provide a draft SOW and billing cadence options by Aug 6. Jonas (me) will be the billing point of contact until a finance lead is assigned.

Owners assigned: Marissa (CS) — overall success plan; Lauren (implementation) — timeline and cutover coordination; Marcus (infra) — deployment runbook; Evelyn (SE) — technical validation and test harness.

If any of these owners need to revise dates, flag in the MAP spreadsheet with the "owner note" column so we can reconcile by Friday Aug 6. I'll circulate updated MAP v0.2 after the kickoff and after the initial artifacts arrive.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Candescent live.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-kickoff-agenda.pdf
